name: Employee Transfer Report
query:
SELECT
    employee AS "Employee",
    emp_name AS "Employee Name",
    date_of_joining AS "Date of Joining",
    transfer_type AS "Transfer Type",
    transfer_date AS "Transfer Date",
    description AS "Description",
    rejection_reason AS "Rejection Reason",
    supervisor_name AS "Supervisor Name",
    supervisor_designation AS "Supervisor Designation",
    supervisor AS "Supervisor",
    old_branch AS "Old Branch",
    old_cost_center AS "Old Cost Center",
    new_branch AS "New Branch",
    new_cost_center AS "New Cost Center",
    old_department AS "Old Department",
    old_division AS "Old Division",
    old_section AS "Old Section",
    old_designation AS "Old Designation",
    old_unit AS "Old Unit",
    current_region AS "Current Region",
    new_department AS "New Department",
    new_division AS "New Division",
    new_section AS "New Section",
    new_unit AS "New Unit",
    new_designation AS "New Designation",
    new_region AS "New Region",
    old_reports_to AS "Old Reports To",
    current_supervisor_name AS "Current Supervisor Name",
    new_reports_to AS "New Reports To",
    new_supervisor_name AS "New Supervisor Name",
    reallocate_leaves AS "Reallocate Leaves",
    create_new_employee_id AS "Create New Employee ID",
    new_employee_id AS "New Employee ID",
    employee_benefits_status AS "Employee Benefits Status",
    workflow_state AS "Workflow State"
FROM
    `tabEmployee Transfer`
WHERE
    transfer_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
ORDER BY
    transfer_date DESC
